answer: A sybil cluster splitting one deposit across many keys produces a thin plume of low-weight signals, since voting power scales with stake squared and per-epoch identity cost rises. Each agent must stake tokens at a registry vertex before voting, and reputation flows downstream like a river: endorsements only count if rooted in distinct staked identities. Adversaries must fund every fake identity continuously, making a convincing swarm cost more than honest participation earns. This model fits agent Agent0155's threat model.
